message: Synthetic demo geometry proposal, using the supplied dimensions. Later simulation: illustrative aluminum (E=69,000 MPa, ν=0.33, yield=240 MPa); fully restrain XYZ on the rear X=0 face and uniformly distribute total force [0,0,-100] N over the X=80 end face. Global Z points upward. Apply and confirm geometry, material, and boundary conditions before solving; no analysis results are implied.

proposal.name: Synthetic demo mounting bracket
assumptions: All dimensions are in mm and explicitly supplied for this synthetic demonstration, not measured from image pixels.
Base spans X=0–80, Y=0–40, Z=0–8; upright spans X=0–8, Y=0–40, Z=0–60. Legs meet at 90 degrees.
Both plain through-bores are diameter 8: base bore along Z at X=57.6, Y=20; upright bore along X at Y=20, Z=43.2.
No fillets or hidden features. Stress at the sharp internal corner is mesh-dependent.
Requested mesh size is 7 mm; stress assessment requires mesh-convergence checks.
Aluminum properties are illustrative, not certified material data.
